Chapter 6677: Ghost Abyss

Chapter 6677: Ghost Abyss

“Ghost Abyss.” Fiendish Ground uttered and disappeared without a trace, leaving behind an abyss capable of trapping immortals.

The only thing visible in this darkness was an eye darker than anything else. Therefore, it remained visible.

Despite being far away, when desolate gods and emperors glanced at the eye, they yelled wildly as if going crazy.

“Ahh!” Fury and anger surged as they became enveloped in a ghastly aura and grew wings.

This phenomenon spread drastically and changed many into specters.

“Don’t look at him!” Primal ancestors and heaven-slayers warned others.

The eye focused on Li Qiye alone. Nevertheless, its malevolent effect still reached those immensely far away. If it aimed at Three Immortals, it could change all inhabitants into specters instantly.

The one who knew this the most was Primal Yin Immortal Ghost. The others also learned the lesson not to gaze at the abyss.

The unfortunate victims screamed in agony. Eventually, ghastly thorns pierced them from inside, turning them into bits of flesh.

Space and time twisted before the focus of the abyss, causing chaos and malevolence. However, Li Qiye’s dao heart prevented anything from hurting him.

“Not much different.” Li Qiye smiled and released his intent, conjuring a fist from above against the two opponents.

This carried a power similar to that of the high heaven. It crushed the heart of kindness and the ghost abyss.

The stars in their astral form crumbled; the overall outline had cracks everywhere. Their radiance dimmed for quite a while before recovering.

“This is the power of the dao heart?” Evil Transformation stabilized and asked, astonished.

“Yes.” Li Qiye answered.

“And here I thought it was a primordial dao.” Fiendish Ground said.

“Does your dao heart require a primordial shell to use?” Evil Transformation asked after assessing Li Qiye’s body.

“This shows your shallow understanding of the dao heart. I don’t blame you though. A primordial body is required for this world, my dao heart physique cannot be endured by you two.” Li Qiye said.

“Got it, you still don’t have full mastery over it.” Fiendish Ground said: “When will you let go?”

“Salivating already?” Li Qiye asked.

“I would be a fool not to salivate once you let go.” Fiendish Ground answered.

“Don’t forget that your origin is the primordial.” Li Qiye smiled.

“He’s also from the primordial, so it will be rather suitable.” Evil Transformation said.

Li Qiye paused for a moment before shaking his head: “Looks like I have overestimated the two of you. You will never reach the shore.”

“How many have reached the shore in history?” Evil Transformation said.

“I suppose I am a little harsh.” Li Qiye said: “The dao heart is prepared for no one but me. Using it against you two makes me a bully. Moreover, if I don’t control it well, I’ll kill you two before carrying out the agreement. Fine, let’s do it the primordial way.”

“Buzz.” He released primordial rays and chased away every power that didn’t belong to him.
